title: Light Time suit packet
description: One packet per metric per minute from the suit gateway (continuous streams), or one per event (cuff reading, check-in answer, test result). The dashboard service attaches 'baseline', 'rule' and 'state' on arrival, then logs it and fans out over WebSocket (SSE fallback).

signal_quality.description: 0-1; readings under 0.6 are shown as RECHECK and never trip ALERT on their own

window_s.description: Seconds summarised into this packet (60 for continuous streams)

baseline.description: Attached by the dashboard: the crewmember's OK band for this metric

rule.description: Attached by the dashboard: the rule that applied, e.g. 'resting HR > baseline+20 for 3 days'

ack.description: When an ALERT was acknowledged on the console or from a push notification
